title: agentarch baseline
description: The failures a project had when it adopted the standard. A ratchet, not an amnesty: entries are removed as they are fixed and never added on update, and the score counts them the whole time.

accepted.description: Keyed by agent and control. A failure absent from here blocks, whatever its severity.

severity.description: The severity at adoption. A control that later became stricter is no longer covered — adopting a baseline must not grandfather a severity that did not exist yet.
